title: Dispatcher park counters for `ReaderPool`
impact: Measurement-only: profile-mode counters (park-total, wake-retry-total, max-parked-concurrent) that quantify the parked-dispatcher path exp 105 / exp 114 targeted indirectly. Wake-retry/park ratio reaches 93 % at concurrency=32 (pool=4), the direct wake-amplification signal. Tree-shaken from release builds. Unblocks future dispatch-area experiments with a non-wall-time evaluation gate
